description: Test recovery and direction of clear parent-child relationships among frozen current category titles, with related noncontainment controls.
approval: User approved the recommendation to select a small varied set from current categories, settle judgments from masks before scores, and run both directions with unchanged TRUE model and cutoff.

selection.reasons: Food items, food preparation, qualified meat-based dishes, coffee activities and appreciation, Bitcoin units, and overlap-versus-containment controls. Two ambiguous initial candidates replaced by clearly scoped existing coffee-consumption and meat-eating categories before any scores.
selection.not_a_holdout: Current collection reused; main agent knows prior results. P09 and P10 repeat TRUE05 negative controls. Some other exact input pairs may have appeared in earlier experiments; audit overlap after freezing without using it to alter selection.
selection.scope_limit: Predominantly food and coffee with one Bitcoin pair and one visual-art/music control. Neither balanced domain transfer nor a full hierarchy evaluation.

semantics: Topical containment of exact frozen category meanings, informed by masks. Not merely shared members, relatedness, literal entity is-a, or full-note matching. Do not rewrite labels, assume one canonical hierarchy, or reopen approved category titles.
hypotheses: TRUE can accept some useful narrower-topic relationships, not only reject unrelated categories.
TRUE can retain direction and reject related but noncontaining subjects with the same fixed decision rules.
reporting: Report valid relationships recovered, reverse directions rejected, and related noncontainment rejections separately for native output and fixed cutoff. Every scored direction remains in its denominator, including unresolved outputs. Display all errors with exact model strings and masks. Do not select a new threshold from these results.
next_decision: Successful recovery with few incorrect links supports trying a partial graph, not declaring general reliability. Numerous misses or false links supports comparing another containment judge before broader graph construction. This experiment does not authorize that next run.

unchanged.titles: Exact v21 titles; no title generation or manual correction.
unchanged.inference: Unmodified true_holdout_probe.run_inference: CPU float32, batch4, four threads, seed0, greedy one beam, max3 output tokens, EOS required, no truncation. Native output and strict >0.142 cutoff reported separately.
unchanged.input: premise: This text is about {B}. hypothesis: This text is about {A}.
unchanged.model_evidence: Only title strings; no masks, notes, expected judgments or reasoning enters model_input.

runner_reuse: fixture.json retains TRUE03 only as the existing input validator's schema discriminator. Runtime experiment is TRUE06. Shared raw DECISIONS.md may say holdout; this selected reused-collection diagnostic is not a holdout.
resources: Cached offline local CPU only; one large model process, at least70GiB available before launch, MemoryMax60G, MemorySwapMax0, CPUQuota400%. No rentals, downloads, purchases, training or external API calls.
